benchmark_source_note: Workload set is the migrated TileOPs benchmark (`benchmarks/ops/bench_pool.py::test_max_pool2d_bench`, manifest entry MaxPool2dFwdOp in tileops/manifest/pool.yaml). 12 parameterisations = 3 smoke (precision only) + 9 tune (3 labels x 3 dtypes). DESIGN.md shapes are reference only.

workloads.label: smoke-1x8x16x16-k3s2p1
workloads.reason: Manifest smoke entry (first, small): precision regression only, excluded from tuning per the smoke contract.

workloads.reason: Manifest smoke entry (first, small): precision regression only, excluded from tuning per the smoke contract.

workloads.label: smoke-1x8x16x16-k3s2p1
workloads.reason: Manifest smoke entry (first, small): precision regression only, excluded from tuning per the smoke contract.

workloads.label: resnet-stem
workloads.reason: Manifest full workload (ResNet stem, 3x3/s2/p1 on 112x112): the largest shape, drives the read-bandwidth ceiling; tuned.

workloads.label: resnet-stem
workloads.reason: Manifest full workload (ResNet stem, 3x3/s2/p1 on 112x112) in bfloat16: f32 accumulator halves the UB budget, so the tiling rule picks its own (bh, ch); tuned.

workloads.label: resnet-stem
workloads.reason: Manifest full workload (ResNet stem) in float32: twice the bytes per element, mte2-bound; tuned.

workloads.label: vgg-block
workloads.reason: Manifest full workload (VGG block, disjoint 2x2/s2 windows): short 56 B output rows pay the per-row store overhead; tuned.

workloads.label: vgg-block
workloads.reason: Manifest full workload (VGG block) in bfloat16: widen path (f32 accumulator + cast back), vector-bound; tuned.

workloads.label: vgg-block
workloads.reason: Manifest full workload (VGG block) in float32: 128 B rows, four channel blocks at ch=32; tuned.

workloads.label: alexnet-ceil
workloads.reason: Manifest full workload (AlexNet-style 55x55 ceil-mode): out_h = 27 has a bad core-split tail, which is what the (bh, ch) rule now prices; tuned.

workloads.label: alexnet-ceil
workloads.reason: Manifest full workload (AlexNet-style 55x55 ceil-mode) in bfloat16: vec-bound widen path, ceil semantics must stay bit-exact; tuned.

workloads.label: alexnet-ceil
workloads.reason: Manifest full workload (AlexNet-style 55x55 ceil-mode) in float32: the ceil-mode large-tile case; tuned.
